<!-- pr-reviewer: 1445e64d347de48c1ff7bb3690b71dfc486443be -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge, after the release tag.** A release cut is open (PR #1694). This PR is a `fix`, but the maintainer should merge it after the tag.

**What looks good**
- The "Fit margin" group and the "Fit to Models" button show only when the shape is not "From model". Box and Cylinder keep them (`stock_page.rs:32`, `stock_page.rs:179`).
- The footer buttons now run by label, not by position. This keeps "Delete" attached to deletion when "Fit to Models" is hidden. The test confirms this.
- Only UI code changed. No command changed. The command-level refusal for from-model fit stays, so callers outside the page are still protected. Undo does not change.
- The change of shape clears only Setup-scope feedback. It clears the status only when the status is still the old refusal. Two extra tests pin these guards.
- The test file `tests/stock_fit.rs` is new (101 lines). `stock_page.rs` has 215 lines. No unwrap, expect or panic was added. No snapshot PNG changed. The decision file is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1683`.

**Results, merged with main (upstream `101d82f9`), run locally** (no self-hosted runner was online)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui`: 778 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored. The 4 `stock_fit` pins pass.
- ui integration binaries (`--test '*'`): no failure.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation run: I made the fit group and the fit button show for from-model stock again. `stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` turned red. I then restored the file. The pins cover the shown case (Box, Cylinder, back to Box) and the hidden case (From model).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- I did not run the native interactive UI. Only the structural tests ran.
- The shape index `2` for "From model" is a literal number in two places (`stock_page.rs:32`, `stock_page.rs:179`). A named constant would be clearer. This is optional.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 1445e64d347de48c1ff7bb3690b71dfc486443be -->
**Needs changes before this PR is offered for merge.** The code and the tests pass. The PR body has no before/after screenshots.

**What looks good**
- The "Fit to models" group shows only for Box and Cylinder stock now (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_page.rs:32`).
- The footer actions run by label, not by button position. "Delete" stays attached to deletion when the fit button is hidden.
- A shape change clears only Setup-scope feedback (`stock_page.rs:44-59`). It clears the status line only when the status still matches the old refusal.
- The command refusal for a from-model fit stays in place. Callers outside the page remain protected.
- Four structural tests pin the behaviour. Two of them check that unrelated feedback survives.
- The decision file is present (`docs/decisions/1683-stock-fit-mode.md`). The body carries a `Changelog:` line and names issue #1683.

**Results (trial-merged with main, on the self-hosted pr-test runner)**
Run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43635967446 — main `101d82f9`, merge test clean.
- Quick gate, ui suites: ok, 0 failed. The `camcraft-ui` lib binary ran 783 tests: 778 passed, 5 ignored, 0 failed.
- `stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` — ok.
- `stock_shape_change_clears_the_fit_refusal` — ok.
- `stock_shape_change_preserves_operation_feedback` — ok.
- `stock_shape_change_preserves_newer_status` — ok.
- The other suite binaries ran 3, 6, 1 and 14 tests: all passed, 0 failed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` — clean.

**Not exercised**
- Native interactive UI, per the PR body. The structural tests cover the visible change: labels, enabled state, and shown or hidden buttons. Pixel snapshots stay a release-lane check (#255).

**Requested before merge**
1. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. The first shows the Stock page with Box selected: the fit group and the "Fit to Models" button are visible. The second shows the page with From model selected: both are gone. The maintainer's standing note on #1209 asks for the screenshots before a UI PR can be offered merge-ready.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new checks compare against the literal shape index 2 (`stock_page.rs:32`). The page already uses numeric match arms in `size_fields`, so this fits the current style. A named constant would read better in later work.
- The feedback clear writes `state.status` and the feedback fields in the page. These hold transient UI state, not document data. Document changes still ride commands, so the command law holds.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
